name: Imre
source:
She is the daughter of the god in charge of Sanctum. She's reckless, putting her heart above her mind in almost all cases. This can sometimes be a problem for the people of Sanctum, but you'll never find someone who loves as hard as she does.

[From [url=https://legendex-games.itch.io/imres-curse-the-prologue]itch.io[/url]]
